Product
& Growth Analyst

Data Processing + Visualisation + Actionable Insights.

Hello I'm Jen,

A Product & Growth Analyst with a Frontend Design background (SaaS and digital products), so I look at numbers the way a designer would: what is the person behind this metric actually trying to do? I work mostly with web and e-commerce analytics (conversion, funnel drop-off, AOV, session quality) and turn it into clear product and growth decisions through data storytelling.

I'm used to working across data, design and stakeholders, so I can explain findings to people who don't live in spreadsheets.
